opening.argument: The video is presented as an ordinary Somoy TV news report on garment workers returning to work after factories reopened in Savar during lockdown. Its title states, "Workers have joined the work of opening the factories Savar News | Lockdown | Somoy tv," framing the subject around workers, factories, Savar, and lockdown. The visual presentation supports that reporting context: a studio presenter appears at a desk, a field reporter holds a microphone near buses and pedestrians, and the presenter and reporter are shown together. Nothing described in the material requests payment, credentials, investment participation, prize claims, or an external benefit scheme, leaving no stated basis for treating the report as deceptive commercial solicitation.
